title: High-Throughput Dynamic Phenotype Recognition for Rice Panicle Analysis
author: Ziyue Guo

steps.title: Collect Rice Images
steps.instruction: Obtain high-resolution images of rice at the heading stage using camera equipment.

steps.title: Select and Annotate Plots
steps.instruction: Select specific plots to investigate panicle number and tillering number, then process the images.

substeps.instruction: Crop the observed plot from the original image.
Annotate the plot image according to ground survey results.

steps.title: Build PR Estimation Model
steps.instruction: Construct a deep CNN (DCNN) for automatically estimating panicle ratio (PR) using the Keras library with the TensorFlow backend.

steps.title: Train Recognition Model
steps.instruction: Train the heading proportion recognition model.

description: The data set is divided into training set, validation set and test set.Model parameters are optimized using training sets and validation sets.
